# Alberta Mentoring Partnership

> Alberta Mentoring Partnership connects mentors with racialized and underrepresented youth across Alberta through community-based mentoring programs, training resources, and organizational partnerships.

AMP provides comprehensive mentoring resources, training modules, and program toolkits designed to support youth development and career pathways. The organization partners with schools, agencies, and community organizations across Alberta to deliver culturally-responsive mentoring initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Alberta Mentoring Partnership (AMP)
- Youth Development
- Mentor Training
- Community Partnerships
- Racialized Youth
- Indigenous Mentoring
- Girls Group Mentoring
- School-Based Mentoring
- Refugee & Newcomer Youth
- Career Pathways

- Community Engagement

- Youth Support
- Mentor Recruitment

## Getting Started

- [Alberta Mentoring Partnership | Your Mentoring Resource](https://albertamentors.ca): Alberta Mentoring Partnership homepage showcasing mentoring resources and career pathways for racialized youth
- [Get Involved | Alberta Mentoring Partnership](https://albertamentors.ca/get-involved): Call-to-action page for becoming a mentor or mentee with AMP programs
- [About AMP | Alberta Mentoring Partnership](https://albertamentors.ca/about-amp): Mission, vision, and organizational overview of Alberta Mentoring Partnership

## Mentoring Training & Resources

- [Resources | Alberta Mentoring Partnership](https://albertamentors.ca/resources): Central hub for mentoring resources, training, and program support materials
- [Mentoring Basics | Alberta Mentoring Partnership](https://albertamentors.ca/mentoring-basics): Educational guide on mentoring fundamentals, role-modeling, and social-emotional skills
- [Mentor/Mentee Training | Alberta Mentoring Partnership](https://albertamentors.ca/mentor-orientation): Online mentor and mentee training modules and certification programs for volunteers
- [Tools Research | Alberta Mentoring Partnership](https://albertamentors.ca/tools-research): Research-based toolkit for mentoring program design and mentor recruitment strategies

## Specialized Mentoring Programs

- [Mentoring in Schools | Alberta Mentoring Partnership](https://albertamentors.ca/mentoring-in-schools): School-based mentoring resources including Reading Buddies and program planning workbooks
- [Mentoring Girls | Alberta Mentoring Partnership](https://albertamentors.ca/webinars/girls-group-mentoring): Girls Group Mentoring Toolkit and implementation resources for ages 9-13
- [Indigenous Mentoring | Alberta Mentoring Partnership](https://albertamentors.ca/indigenousmentoring): Guide for culturally-responsive Indigenous mentoring with community engagement strategies
- [Children Youth Care Mentoring Project | Alberta Mentoring Partnership](https://albertamentors.ca/children-youth-care-mentoring-project-2): Research-based mentoring program for children and youth in care with University of Alberta
- [Request Mentoring Refugee, Immigrant & Newcomer Youth | Alberta Mentoring Partnership](https://albertamentors.ca/resources/request-mentoring-refugee-immigrant-newcomer-youth): Resource request form and toolkit for refugee, immigrant, and newcomer youth mentoring

## Partnerships & Community

- [Become a Partner | Alberta Mentoring Partnership](https://albertamentors.ca/be-a-partner): Partnership program information for schools, agencies, and organizational collaboration
- [AMP Partners | Alberta Mentoring Partnership](https://albertamentors.ca/partners): Directory of AMP partner organizations and mentoring agencies in Alberta
- [AMP Builders | Alberta Mentoring Partnership](https://albertamentors.ca/builders): Directory listing of AMP Builder partner organizations across Alberta

## About the Organization

- [Meet the Team | Alberta Mentoring Partnership](https://albertamentors.ca/meet-the-team): Team directory and staff contacts for Alberta Mentoring Partnership leadership
